available_evidence_sources.quote: **Completed a broader polynomial counting and exact-sampling construction: faithful modules with rank-one socle action, including nonfree modules and non-chain algebras.** This removes the \(2^{as^2}\) residue-character factor on that class, allowing unrestricted matrix degree \(s\) and growing full affine codimension \(aes^2\).
available_evidence_sources.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

proof_availability.classification_scope: For a split local Frobenius Fq-algebra A of dimension e, faithful module V of dimension m, actual socle-generator action N of rank one, the complete tensor M_s(A), a prescribed unit phase and every complete target Z, the source reports polynomial exact counting and exact uniform factor sampling. The dimensions e and m need not coincide; modules need not be free or chain modules.
unavailable_or_unclassified: The raw recognizer retains commutative characteristic-two full-tensor/acquired-parent/unit-phase admission. A general faithful-module branch remains 2^(a s^2) times polynomial; polynomial witness search is separate and supplies no unknown population or uniform sample. Higher socle rank, nonunit phases and arbitrary original-bit/row-prefix conditioning remain open. A prior mixed-module sampler basis-ordering defect and reviewed repair are reported, but the exact affected/repaired files were not acquired. Warm sequential timing controls show no advantage.
